title: Liu et al. 2025 — Lower limb motor imagery EEG dataset based on the multi-paradigm and longitudinal-training of stroke patients (Tianjin University)
description: Scalp EEG recordings from 27 stroke patients performing a lower-limb motor imagery task under a multi-paradigm protocol with longitudinal, repeated-session training. The dataset supports research on motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces for lower-limb and gait rehabilitation after stroke. It is distributed in BIDS format and was collected at Tianjin University.
methods_description: Scalp EEG recordings were acquired during a lower-limb motor imagery task (`task-imagery`) in stroke patients undergoing rehabilitation. The study employed a multi-paradigm protocol with a longitudinal training design involving repeated sessions across 27 participants.
